verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Public API, webhooks, and a live, OAuth-gated MCP server (confirmed by runtime probe) that let developers integrate meeting data into custom workflows, which supports 'building against Otter programmatically,' but no evidence names an official SDK (Python/JS/etc.) or provides SDK-style client libraries — only raw API/webhook/MCP endpoints are documented. missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation/libraries, code samples, language coverage, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
